summary: Global climate change, drought, and degradation of soil health is making crop rotation decisions more difficult for farmers. As a solution for this problem, SFMAS is a smart decision support tool that combines NASA Earth observation data with local soil information. The system gives farmers opportunity to digitalize their fields either by drawing on a satellite map or walking in the field with phone GPS offline without internet in rural areas. The infrastructure, which calculates the area of field from the determined coordinate matrix, analyzes satellite data from SMAP (soil moisture), NASA POWER (climate),GPM (Overall weather activities), and  LST (temperature)  By blending the obtained scientific data with farmer's priorities, at least three different crop rotation strategies are generated. Presented with an interactive map interface, these strategies transparently report why they are recommended, the satellite evidences, benefits, and risks. Bringing traditional experience together with satellite technology, the platform aims to prevent soil fatigue, reduce water stress, and spread sustainable agriculture.
details: SFMAS is a smart decision support tool designed to help farmers overcome the difficulties of crop rotation decisions caused by global climate change, drought, and degradation of soil health. The system works by allowing farmers to digitalize their fields either by drawing on a satellite map or by walking in the field with phone GPS offline without internet in rural areas. Next, the infrastructure calculates the area of the field from the determined coordinate matrix and analyzes satellite data from SMAP (soil moisture), NASA POWER (climate), GPM (overall weather activities), and LST (temperature). By blending these obtained scientific data with the farmer's priorities, the platform generates at least three different crop rotation strategies. Presented with an interactive map interface, these strategies transparently report why they are recommended along with their satellite evidences, benefits, and risks. Ultimately, by bringing traditional experience together with satellite technology, SFMAS aims to prevent soil fatigue, reduce water stress, and spread sustainable agriculture.
